questions.question: At Miletus, Paul sent a message to Ephesus asking certain people to come to him. Who did he send for?
The Holy Spirit warned Paul that chains and afflictions awaited him. What did Paul say mattered more to him than his life?

answers.text: Finishing the ministry Jesus gave him
Seeing his friends one more time

questions.question: Paul warned the church elders of Ephesus that after he left, which savage animals would come in among the flock?
